data.title: 双叶理央 · 图书馆最深处的高深书籍
data.description: 图书馆角落，她抱着一摞远超高中水平的物理书找座位，眼镜稍稍滑下鼻梁；找到位置后立刻进入阅读状态，周围喧嚣与她无关。
data.action: 图书馆角落，她抱着一摞远超高中水平的物理书找座位，眼镜稍稍滑下鼻梁
data.promptProse: With a stack of thick physics books against her cardigan, Rio settles at the library table and opens the top volume, following its argument immediately. Her slightly slipped glasses reveal concentrated brown eyes. An empty chair stands beside the table and a quiet window beyond the medium side view. Afternoon light traces the stacked page edges and loosely waving hair, leaving the lower books in layered shade.
